title: CHANGELOG.md and the version-to-changelog check
goal: Every package version has a changelog entry, enforced in CI
acceptance: tools/check-changelog.mjs with a test; npm run check:changelog in CI and check:fast
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no consuming project's real data, secrets or tokens in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the upfront step plan: scoped to one PR, at most 1 focused day(s). Not a measurement.
